name: Chaos Andersen
original_name: カオス・アンデルセン
source:
The final opponent in the 2nd main quest's episode 16 "The Final World Part 1".

A swelled, forcibly mutated form of Deus Prometheus. He sends a few Chaostellers to fend off the party while he stays behind for recovery, until he is able to walk again.
